conversationalSummary.text: TODAY’s best bet looks to be Almagreira around the evening window, but I’m treating it as a cam-check situation because the wind angle is pretty poor for that spot. Surfline/MEO Beachcam should be my first look before I even leave, since cross-onshore wind could easily turn it messy despite the size. If the cams show it cleaned up and not too blown out, then I’d go for that evening—otherwise I’d skip it and save the drive.
